title: List Page - Verify that user should be able to delete Data Source column.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page

steps.action: Click on the check box for the column name and click on the delete button
steps.expectedResult: Confirmation pop up window should be open
Record should be deleted and validation message should be populate for the same.
